description: Scan several YouTube channels at once and return the strongest outliers across all of them, each measured against its own channel's baseline. Call this when the user wants to see what is working across a niche or a set of competitors rather than one channel. Costs about 5 quota units per channel.

channels.description: Channel URLs, @handles or ids, separated by spaces, commas or newlines

name: compare_channels
title: Rank outliers across several channels
